## Objectives

Teach the real, standard startup-to-scale-up business disciplines this
cluster covers, as frameworks and process, never jurisdiction-specific
rules:

- Opportunity discovery and go-to-market strategy.
- Fundraising and valuation fundamentals.
- M&A foundations (process and framework, not jurisdiction-specific
  deal law).
- IP/brand/data strategy at the group level.
- Platform strategy and ecosystem orchestration.

## Modules

1. Opportunity discovery and go-to-market strategy.
2. Fundraising and valuation fundamentals.
3. M&A foundations — process and framework only.
4. IP/brand/data strategy at the group level.
5. Platform strategy and ecosystem orchestration.
6. Boundary discipline — legacy `GRP-01`/`GRP-02` cited, never
   rebuilt; `GRP-EXT-01` internal code never collides with legacy
